introduction: Golden Empire Gleaners helps address hunger in Kern County through food and community referral partnerships. Contact the organization to confirm the appropriate way to obtain food.

who: People needing food should ask about the applicable referral or distribution process. A warehouse address is not confirmation of unrestricted walk-in pickup.
sections.get: Food access can involve a referral from a county caseworker, school, church or other partner. The organization also lists volunteer-for-food and senior programs; ask which route fits your circumstances.
sections.docs: Before travelling, ask whether a referral or any household information is required. If you already receive county services, ask your caseworker about a food referral.
sections.apply: Call 661-324-2767 or follow the Obtaining Food instructions. Confirm the pickup procedure and schedule directly.
sections.after: Keep referral details and confirm where and when to collect food. Ask about future pickups and alternatives if travel or the appointment time is difficult.
sections.sources:
• Golden Empire Gleaners food access
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Can my school help with a referral?
The provider lists schools among its referral partners. Ask your child’s school office.
Can my county caseworker refer me?
The food instructions advise people receiving county services to contact their caseworker.
Should I assume the warehouse serves all walk-ins?
No. Confirm the food access process first.
Does this application also enroll me in CalFresh?
No. CalFresh has a separate county benefits application.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
